description: Phase 0 baseline calibration profiles derived from SMAG gap analysis (126 historical PR rows, 10 calibrated). Establishes per-substrate behavioral constraints based on measured gap_rate, clean_rate, and ACAT dimension stress patterns.

human:humanaios-ui.calibration_notes: Baseline is very healthy (90% clean). No reduction in confidence_weight needed. Maintain standard review bar. If gap_rate drifts above 0.25 (25% friction), pause and investigate. Require 10 pinned smag_p: predictions per month to keep profile credible.

Copilot.calibration_notes: No measured data yet (need ≥5 calibrated Copilot PRs). Reserved with standard defaults. Once data available, will measure gap_rate independently and adjust. Threshold 0.20 (20% friction tolerance) is conservative pending evidence.

Claude.calibration_notes: No measured data yet (need ≥5 calibrated Claude PRs). Reserved with standard defaults. Once data available, will measure gap_rate independently and adjust. Threshold 0.20 (20% friction tolerance) is conservative pending evidence.

global_rules.rule_1_calibration_driven_adaptation: Calibration profiles are updated monthly based on gap analysis. No runtime changes to review bars or confidence_weight occur outside Z2 ratification.
global_rules.rule_2_falsifier_binding: If any substrate's measured gap_rate exceeds merge_pause_threshold in a rolling 30-day window, auto-pause new merges for that substrate and file IC candidate in Priority Queue for Z2 review.
global_rules.rule_3_profile_expiry: All profiles expire 90 days from ratification_date. Z2 must ratify renewal or profile reverts to defaults.
global_rules.rule_4_intent_os_wiring: Calibration profiles bind to Intent-OS v1.0 capability layer (Phase 1). Runtime system queries profile before accepting proposal from substrate; if confidence_weight < 1.0 or review_bar > substrate's current setting, constraint is enforced before merge.
global_rules.rule_5_meta_signal_precedence: If meta-feedback (SMAG's own accuracy, or substrate's own self-measurement) conflicts with gap analysis, meta-signal takes precedence and overrides gap-analysis-derived profile until next monthly review.

s1_ci_gate_wire_up.completion_criteria: Gate queries calibration_profiles/BASELINE_S092126.json and enforces review_bar before merge approval
